title: SEC and DOJ Expand Antitrust Subpoenas Over NVIDIA GPU Distribution & Bundling
summary: Federal regulators have escalated inquiry into NVIDIA (NVDA) market practices, issuing civil subpoenas concerning AI chip allocations and software lock-in clauses.

title: Taiwan Semiconductor (TSMC) Flags Advanced CoWoS Packaging Bottleneck
summary: TSMC Chairman stated that advanced packaging supply will remain constrained through Q3, causing minor delivery delay risks for key customers including Apple and Broadcom.

title: Federal Reserve Holds Benchmark Rate Steady, Signals Neutral Policy Stance
summary: The FOMC voted unanimously to maintain target federal funds rate, observing steady inflation moderation and solid labor market trends.

title: Constellation Energy and Hyperscalers Sign Landmark 20-Year Nuclear Power Agreement
summary: Constellation Energy (CEG) announced a multibillion-dollar contract to supply 1.2 GW of dedicated zero-carbon baseload nuclear energy to next-generation AI datacenter clusters.

title: Viking Therapeutics Reports Phase 2 Oral GLP-1 Obesity Trial Exceeds Efficacy Targets
summary: Viking Therapeutics (VKTX) reported statistically significant weight reduction in its oral dual agonist tablet trial, positioning the company as a key competitor to subcutaneous injectables.
